syn: Food-led factual entertainment title following a Belgian burger business — kitchen operations, customer drama and the daily reality of running a fast-food establishment.

title: Loïc, een restaurant in 100 dagen
syn: Restaurant-build factual entertainment following young chef Loïc through the compressed challenge of opening a full restaurant from scratch in 100 days.

title: De Keuken van de Meester
syn: Chef-led food entertainment following a culinary master through seasonal menus, kitchen philosophy and the craft of high-end Belgian gastronomy.

title: Snackmasters: Readymade
syn: Brand-challenge cooking format: top chefs must perfectly recreate beloved readymade snack products using only fresh ingredients — humbling, funny and technically demanding.

title: Mijn Restaurant
syn: Restaurant competition format: amateur restaurateurs open their homes as pop-up restaurants and are scored by each other — Belgian hospitality, food and social chemistry.

title: SOS Piet
syn: Classic Belgian food-help format in which chef Piet Huysentruyt rescues struggling home cooks and families through expert intervention, recipes and a warm, no-nonsense approach.

title: Open Keuken met Sandra Bekkari
syn: Lifestyle and food-entertainment title following nutritionist and health expert Sandra Bekkari in her kitchen — accessible, wellness-driven cooking for a Belgian prime-time audience.

title: De Keuken van Sofie
syn: Long-running chef and lifestyle factual title still active on VTM GO — Sofie Dumont's approachable cooking programme built around warmth, seasonal ingredients and Belgian home cooking.

title: Sergio Over De Grens
syn: Travel-food factual entertainment following chef Sergio Herman beyond Belgium's borders — international culinary culture, personal storytelling and gastronomic exploration.

title: Good Luck Guys
syn: 12 pampered reality alumni volunteer to swap luxury for a back-to-basics adventure on an isolated tropical beach. In 'adventure duos', they compete in challenges and live without home comforts or cosmetics. K7 Rising Format Star 2023. Eight international versions including Germany, Poland, Nordic; distributed by Banijay Entertainment.

title: The Fifty
syn: 50 reality TV personalities face challenges devised by a mysterious Game Master concealed behind a lion mask inside a grand venue. Strategic, spectacular and scalable. Season 4 in France was the show's highest-ever launch. Five international adaptations including Poland, Germany and India (2026). Distributed by Banijay Entertainment.

title: The Detective Club
syn: 18 celebrities are invited by a mysterious host — when the host's beloved dog Kiki goes missing, guests embark on a thrilling investigation to find two hidden culprits. A strategic game of deduction and deceit: clues, interrogations and €20,000 on the line. Each episode ends with contestants naming their prime suspect. The dog-nappers hold the power to eliminate a fellow player each round.

title: Shaolin Heroes
syn: Premium adventure reality in which contestants undergo intensive Shaolin monk training under genuine masters — physical endurance, mental focus and spiritual discipline over several weeks. The Danish original surpassed TV2's primetime slot average by 31% and was immediately recommissioned. International format sales active.

title: Rush
syn: A travel-based reality competition from Endemol Shine Australia in which teams race across multiple global destinations against time and each other. High-octane adventure, local culture challenges and unpredictable eliminations in a format built for peak primetime.

title: Faking It (Reboot)
syn: A modern reimagining of the Channel 4 classic after 20 years: ordinary people are trained in unfamiliar skills — piano, ballet, car mechanics — and must convince a panel of experts they are genuine professionals. Updated for a new generation with higher production values and fresh skill categories.

title: 30 Dates in 30 Nights
syn: One single goes on a speed-dating marathon — 30 different dates across 30 consecutive nights — searching for a genuine connection. The relentless format exposes modern dating anxieties, the paradox of choice and what it really takes to feel a spark.

title: Party Workers
syn: Long-running French reality competition in which groups of young adults organise and run a series of parties, competing on execution, creativity and crowd reaction. A durable, reliable W9 format with 20+ seasons produced — remarkable longevity in the competitive unscripted landscape.

title: LEGO Masters: Out of the Box
syn: An extension of the hugely successful LEGO Masters franchise: teams tackle the most ambitious, large-scale building challenges yet, pushing the format's engineering and creativity boundaries. Distributed by Banijay Entertainment for international adaptation.

title: The Insider
syn: The first format to stem from the Endemol Shine Australia–TBS co-development partnership. A reinvention of Junya Ueda's Actor vs Reactors concept: a hidden insider among a group secretly knows the rules of each challenge, while others must figure out what's really going on — before it's too late.

title: The Final Circle
syn: 50 players start on the outer ring of a 360-degree studio arena. The ultimate test of brainpower — memory, logic, language, calculation and visual skills all tested under pressure. As they advance, questions get harder and the circle tightens. The last competitor standing enters the 'Final Circle' where strategy, speed and brainpower collide for the grand prize. Created by Satisfaction for TF1.

title: Reality Kings on Safari
syn: From the producers of the hit Reality Queens franchise: male Dutch reality stars swap likes and luxury for survival in the wild. Split into rival camps without phones, home comforts or easy exits, they navigate wilderness challenges testing both brawn and brains. A gender-flipped follow-up to the Videoland celebrity-reality hit.

title: World's Wildest Race
syn: Two celebrity teams are sent on the ultimate road trip challenge — a journey as much about friendship and fun as competition. The race takes them through unpredictable terrain and situations, combining travel adventure with celebrity chemistry and genuine competitive edge.

title: Aller Simple: La téléréalité
syn: Ten strangers are locked in a remote cabin, each hiding personal secrets that may cost them the game if revealed. A social experiment format where concealed truths and strategic gameplay collide in isolation. From Fremantle Canada for Bell Media's streaming platform Crave.

title: Match My Ex
syn: Contestants' former partners take control of their new dating choices — creating a psychologically charged mix of reconciliation, jealousy and confrontation. The ex holds the power to interfere, approve or sabotage incoming romantic connections.

title: The 1% Club
syn: 100 contestants face questions that only 1% of the population can answer correctly. Contestants are eliminated as the difficulty rises — from questions 90% can answer to those only 1% can. Hosted by Lee Mack. Already adapted internationally; strong Fox development track.

title: Gladiators UK S2
syn: The second series of the BBC's hugely successful revival of the Gladiators format. Contenders vs superhuman Gladiators in head-to-head arena challenges — the Eliminator, the Wall, Hang Tough — updated with a fresh roster of Gladiators and an even bigger production scale.

title: I Can See Your Voice (UK)
syn: The UK adaptation of the Korean singing guessing game: a contestant must identify which of six strangers can actually sing — without hearing them sing — based on visual clues, mini-performances and lip-sync tests, before the big reveal.

title: Holey Moley (UK/International)
syn: Fremantle's global production hub for the epic mini-golf competition series — competitors face absurd, oversized miniature golf courses in head-to-head eliminations for a cash prize. The US original (ABC) inspired multiple international rollouts now coordinated through Fremantle's global production network.

title: Silence is Gold
syn: A unique take on the gameshow format: contestants must resist laughter in front of 30 professional comedians attempting to make them crack. Comedy and pressure collide in a format that puts personal composure — not knowledge — at the centre of the competition.

title: The Piano S2
syn: The second series of the warmly received talent discovery format: amateur pianists discovered through surprise performances in public spaces — train stations, shopping centres — with mentor-led guidance and emotional reveals that have made this one of Channel 4's most distinctive factual-entertainment hits.

title: Ladette to Lady (Reboot)
syn: The revival of the cult early-2000s finishing-school reality format for a new generation. Young women with unpolished edges are guided through etiquette, elocution and social refinement challenges by a panel of tutors — updated framing balances nostalgic entertainment with modern sensibility.

title: The Neighbourhood
syn: Ben Shephard hosts this street-based popularity contest: families and households on a street compete across a series of neighbourhood challenges, with community spirit, rivalry and £250,000 on the line. A warm, inclusive primetime competition that brings reality TV out of the villa and onto the doorstep.

title: Game of Wool
syn: A competitive knitting and textile craft series for More4 — amateur makers take on increasingly ambitious knitting and fibre-art challenges judged on skill, creativity and precision. A niche passion format that has found a surprisingly devoted audience on Channel 4's specialist strand.

title: Genius Game (ITV)
syn: An international format adaptation for ITV: contestants face a range of intellectual and lateral-thinking challenges designed to identify and celebrate raw cognitive ability across memory, strategy, logic and creative problem-solving.

title: Clone Heads
syn: A celebrity lookalike quiz format in which contestants must identify famous faces from near-perfect lookalike doubles — celebrities themselves, their celebrity lookalikes and real strangers are mixed together to create an increasingly challenging guessing game.

title: VS School: The Ultimate Hide and Seek
syn: A large-scale hide and seek game pitting ordinary players against an entire school — 100,000+ applications received in Japan and a dedicated Danish adaptation optioned by Strong Productions. Created by Fuji TV and launched globally at MIPCOM 2023. Already a viral phenomenon with international schools applying.

title: Atypical Critics
syn: A unique culinary format featuring autistic food critics who bring exceptional sensory precision and honest, unfiltered feedback to food and restaurant reviews. The format celebrates neurodiversity as a genuine culinary superpower — warmly received and internationally positioned as a distinctive, feel-good food show.

title: Crime Scene Zero
syn: The legendary Korean role-playing mystery game show relaunches on Netflix. Six celebrity 'agents' investigate meticulously constructed murder scenarios — every player is simultaneously suspect and detective. Special guests join each episode. The show that defined the 'situated variety' genre in Korea, now reaching 190+ countries on Netflix.

title: Agents of Mystery
syn: Six celebrity agents probe bizarre, unexplained incidents that cannot be solved by science alone. Director Jung Jong-yeon (The Devil's Plan, Society Game) creates a hybrid adventure-mystery format where improvisation meets high-concept investigation. Season 2 expanded outdoors; Season 3 in production.

title: Three Idiots in Kenya
syn: Netflix's first collaboration with legendary Korean variety producer Na Yeong-seok (Three Meals a Day, Fishing Village). Stars Lee Su-geun, Eun Ji-won and Kyuhyun on a comedic and unpredictable journey across Kenya — warmth, chaos and genuine human connection across vast cultural distance.

title: The Devil's Plan S3
syn: The third season of Jung Jong-yeon's cerebral strategy competition. 12 brilliant minds compete in an isolated luxury setting through games of logic, deception and psychological warfare. Following S2's massive global crossover, S3 is in production with expanded game mechanics.

title: Better Late Than Single S2
syn: The second season of the dating format for adults who have never been in a relationship — 'eternal singles' undergo an intensive inside-out transformation before taking their first romantic steps with expert coaching support.

title: My Name Is Gabriel
syn: A celebrity reality format following Korean star Gabriel through personal milestones, creative projects and the intersection of private and public life — combining the Korean entertainer docusoap tradition with Disney+'s broader Asia-Pacific lifestyle slate.

title: The Fifty (India)
syn: The Indian adaptation of Banijay's international hit: 50 reality TV stars compete inside a grand Mahal, facing challenges from a mysterious lion-masked Game Master. The fifth international version of Les Cinquante — launched February 2026. Scale, spectacle and social strategy built for a massive Indian audience.

title: Good Luck Guys (Nordic/Amazon)
syn: The Nordic adaptation of the Banijay survival-beach format, one of the first major Amazon Prime Video unscripted commissions in the Scandinavian market. Reality alumni trade luxury for challenges on an isolated beach in adventure duos.

title: Silence of the North
syn: An NRK-commissioned nature and endurance reality format in which participants live in extreme northern Norwegian wilderness conditions — above the Arctic Circle — surviving with minimal modern tools. Equal parts survival challenge and meditative nature television.

title: Fuji TV: Hole in the Wall (Global revival)
syn: The iconic Fuji TV physical gameshow format — foam walls with human-shaped cutouts hurtle toward contestants who must contort themselves to fit through — continues its global revival across new markets, undimmed after 25 years.

title: Fuji TV: Run for Money
syn: Fuji TV's classic large-scale urban chase format: contestants receive a cash bounty for every minute they evade professional 'hunters' across a designated city zone. One of Japanese TV's most exported formats; continues to find new adaptation markets globally.

title: The 1% Club (Fox)
syn: The US adaptation of the ITV hit: 100 contestants face increasingly difficult questions that only 1% of the population can answer. Wrong answers mean elimination. The last one standing wins a huge prize. Nation's Dumbest competitor and part of Fox's growing UK-origin gameshow portfolio.

title: Nation's Dumbest (Fox)
syn: Fox adaptation of the BBC format celebrating the gloriously stupid things people do — based on real viral events. BBC Studios' fastest-travelling format of 2024-25, already on TF1, ProSieben, TV2 Norway, TV4 Sweden and now Fox.

title: Caught in the Middle (Spain)
syn: The Spanish adaptation of Talpa's calibrated trivia format, produced by Fremantle Spain in partnership with Talpa Studios at Talpa's international production hub in the Netherlands. A duo at the centre of a giant LED arena face 100 opponents — rewarding precision over overconfidence.

title: Match My Ex (International)
syn: International rollout of the psychological dating format where contestants' ex-partners control their new romantic choices — creating explosive confrontations between past and present. Multiple territory discussions across European and Latin American markets.

title: Lego Masters (Australia) S6
syn: The continuing flagship Australian season of the global LEGO Masters franchise — the show that launched 20+ international versions. Amateur teams build extraordinary LEGO structures in progressive elimination rounds judged by the ultimate LEGO expert panel.

title: Edvins lustgård
syn: A Swedish celebrity-led feel-good factual entertainment format in which TV presenter and cultural figure Edvin tends his garden and estate — a warmly received lifestyle and personality format reflecting a broader Nordic trend toward slower, nature-connected television.

title: Roast on the Coast
syn: Swedish celebrity roast format for Amazon Prime Video: famous Swedish faces are skewered by their peers in a beachside comedy event format — combining the US roast tradition with Nordic self-deprecating humour and a summer outdoor setting.

title: Formel E-livet
syn: Norwegian format following a group of people committed to living more sustainably — documenting the real challenges and lifestyle adjustments of reducing environmental impact in a Scandinavian context. Factual entertainment with a social conscience.

title: Sommerhytten
syn: A Danish summer-dating format in which single contestants share a holiday cottage and navigate budding romances in the relaxed, sun-lit atmosphere of a Danish summer. Gentle, character-driven and warmly received by Danish primetime audiences.

title: Bonde søker kone
syn: Norwegian Farmer Wants a Wife — single Norwegian farmers invite city and country hopefuls to their remote farms in search of lasting rural romance. One of NRK's most reliable and best-loved primetime formats, running for many seasons.

title: Reality Queens on Safari
syn: Female Dutch reality TV stars travel together on an African safari adventure, stripped of their usual social media lifestyles. The follow-up to the original Reality Queens franchise: survival challenges, wildlife encounters and the group dynamics of Dutch celebrity women far outside their comfort zone.

title: Dames op de Boerderij
syn: Dutch women celebrities spend time on a traditional working farm — helping with daily agricultural tasks, livestock care and farm chores far removed from their professional lives. A warm, character-driven format combining celebrity lifestyle reality with authentic rural Dutch life.

title: Plankgas
syn: A Dutch driving adventure format in which celebrities take on increasingly extreme and unusual driving challenges across varied terrain — from city circuits to off-road wilderness. High-octane entertainment with Dutch celebrity chemistry.

title: Goud & Groen
syn: A Dutch factual entertainment format exploring sustainable living, green entrepreneurship and environmental innovation — following individuals and businesses making the transition to greener practices with warmth, practicality and genuine inspiration.

title: Pubers op Wielen
syn: Dutch teenagers and their parents travel together in campervans across Europe, the confined space of a moving vehicle forcing honest conversations, tested patience and unexpected moments of genuine connection between generations.

title: Jeopardy! Celebrity
syn: The celebrity spin-off of America's most iconic quiz show — famous faces compete in the classic question-and-answer format with a dedicated celebrity focus. Running alongside the civilian flagship, it has become a reliable primetime fixture on ABC.

title: The Price Is Right (Celebrity)
syn: Celebrity editions of the beloved pricing gameshow continue to deliver primetime event television — famous faces playing the classic pricing games for charity in a warm, inclusive format that has outlasted every trend in American television.

title: Are You Smarter Than A 5th Grader? (Revival)
syn: The revival of the global school-knowledge franchise: adults face grade-school questions with celebrity help — simultaneously humbling and hilarious. Multiple international territory discussions ongoing from the Fox relaunch.

title: The Weakest Link (Revival)
syn: The international revival of the BBC classic continues: nine contestants collaborate to bank prize money but vote off the weakest player each round. The brutal elimination mechanic and sharp hosting style remain as compelling as ever.

title: I Can See Your Voice (US)
syn: The American adaptation of the Korean singing guessing game: contestants and celebrity panellists try to identify which of six strangers can really sing without hearing them — visual clues, lip-sync tests and increasingly elaborate performance reveals.

title: The Crystal Maze (Revival)
syn: The beloved adventure gameshow returns: teams navigate themed zones — Aztec, Medieval, Industrial, Futuristic — collecting time crystals through skill, physical and mental challenges, culminating in the iconic Crystal Dome finale. Now revived with updated zones and fresh celebrity specials.

title: Wheel of Fortune (Rebrand)
syn: America's longest-running gameshow transitions from its Pat Sajak era to a new host — Ryan Seacrest — while retaining the word-puzzle format that has made it a national institution for over 40 years.

title: Family Feud (International)
syn: The Steve Harvey-hosted US format continues to roll out internationally — families face off on survey-based questions in a warm, accessible gameshow that has proven its adaptability across every major television market.

title: Pointless (International)
syn: The BBC quiz format in which contestants aim to find correct answers given by as few survey respondents as possible continues to expand internationally — a beloved reverse-knowledge format now with multiple active adaptations.

title: The Wall (International)
syn: The giant pinball-style prize wall format continues to travel — contestants drop balls down a towering wall to win or lose fortunes as the balls bounce unpredictably across pegs. A visually stunning, emotionally intense format with global appeal.

title: Project Runway (US Revival)
syn: The fashion competition titan returns after a hiatus — designers create looks under severe time and budget pressure, facing elimination each week at a runway show judged by industry experts. A 2025 comeback with a new cast and updated format structure.

title: Top Chef: Germany
syn: The German edition of the prestigious culinary competition continues — professional chefs face elimination through Quickfire challenges and high-concept Elimination Challenges judged by culinary luminaries.

title: MasterChef: The Professionals (UK) S17
syn: Professional chefs compete in the most demanding edition of the MasterChef franchise — Gregg Wallace and Monica Galetti challenge restaurant-trained cooks through technical precision tests and increasingly ambitious creative briefs.

title: The Great Pottery Throw Down S6
syn: Amateur potters compete at the wheel in the Channel 4 craft competition that has built a devoted global audience — technical challenges, glaze tests and sculptural ambition judged by expert ceramicists in a warm, creative atmosphere.

title: Ninja Warrior (International)
syn: The iconic Japanese obstacle course competition — enormous walls, spinning wheels, unstable bridges and the legendary final stage — continues its global dominance with new national editions and international specials across all major markets.

title: SAS: Australia S3
syn: The Australian celebrity edition of the Special Forces selection format returns for a third season — famous Australian faces subjected to real SAS-style physical and psychological selection tests by actual former special forces personnel.

title: Kitchen Cabinet (Australia)
syn: Australian politicians are visited at home by journalist Annabel Crabb, who cooks them dinner while conducting an intimate political interview — a low-key, disarming format that has become one of ABC's most distinctive and beloved unscripted titles.

title: Love Island Games
syn: The Love Island spin-off bringing alumni from multiple international editions together in a competitive villa format — couples compete in challenges against each other, with the most compatible pair winning. Peacock's premium streaming spin-off.

title: Claim to Fame S3
syn: Third season of the identity-guessing competition in which celebrity relatives must conceal their famous connections while unmasking others. A clever, accessible reality format that consistently delivers social media moments.

title: The Traitors: Germany
syn: The German edition of the global deception format — Faithfuls and Traitors in a remote German location, with a uniquely German cast navigating the psychological warfare of the most talked-about reality format of the decade.

title: Perfect Match S2
syn: The second season of Netflix's all-star dating crossover — alumni from Love Is Blind, Too Hot to Handle, The Mole and other franchises compete to form the most compatible couple. Social strategy meets genuine emotional stakes in a Mexican villa.

title: Love Island: All Stars S2
syn: The second series of the returning islanders edition — fan-favourite Love Island alumni given another shot at love. High social media engagement and strong Peacock streaming performance in the US market.

title: The Ultimatum: South Africa
syn: South African couples on the brink of marriage separate and trial-date others for six weeks, before deciding whether to commit, walk away or choose their trial partner — a major Netflix unscripted commission for the South African market.

title: Ex on the Beach (UK) S14
syn: Singles searching for love on a beach paradise are repeatedly ambushed by their exes — the archetypal chaos-dating format continues to deliver social media moments across its fourteenth UK season.

title: First Dates Mexico
syn: The Mexican adaptation of the beloved Channel 4 blind-date restaurant format — produced by WBITVP for TelevisaUnivision's Hispanic-language network UniMás. Warm, intimate and built around the universal human experience of a first date.

title: Married at First Sight: Sweden
syn: The Swedish edition of the expert-matched marriage experiment — relationship scientists and psychologists match strangers who meet only at the altar, with cameras following the weeks of cohabitation and the final commitment ceremony decision.

title: My Mum Your Dad (Australia)
syn: The Australian adaptation of the ITV format: single parents head to a countryside retreat for a second shot at romance, with their adult children watching remotely and able to intervene in their parents' romantic choices.

title: Dated and Related (Brazil)
syn: Brazilian adaptation of the Netflix dating experiment in which singles search for love while their siblings or relatives live alongside them, observing and commenting — a local take on the format that tests whether family dynamics help or hinder love.

title: Celebrity Apprentice: Australia S8
syn: Australian celebrity edition of the classic business reality format — famous faces compete in business challenges under the guidance of a boardroom titan, with one fired at each episode's end. Strong Nine primetime performer.

title: The Genius Game
syn: The original Korean cerebral elimination competition that inspired The Devil's Plan and much of the global strategy-game reality wave. Contestants with exceptional IQ and game theory knowledge compete in complex logical games — a cult favourite returning to streaming.

title: Street Man Fighter
syn: The male-facing companion to Street Woman Fighter: male street dance crews battle through high-energy choreography competitions judged by professionals and public vote — showcasing Korean hip-hop and street culture on a massive primetime stage.

title: Physical: 100 Italy
syn: Netflix's Italian adaptation of the Korean breakout physical competition: 100 of Italy's most elite athletes and physical specimens compete in large-scale endurance and strength challenges to find the perfect Italian physique.

title: The Trust: A Game of Greed S2
syn: The second season of Netflix's psychological money game: eleven strangers share a $250,000 pot — but every vote to eliminate someone means the eliminated player takes their portion of the prize. Pure social psychology and greed mechanics.

title: The Traitors: Spain
syn: The Spanish edition of the global deception format — among the most enthusiastically received in Europe. Faithfuls and Traitors in a Spanish castle setting, with a passionate Spanish audience making it one of 2024's biggest reality events.

title: The Traitors: Sweden
syn: The Swedish edition of the Traitors format, capitalising on the Scandinavian love of deception-based reality and building on the format's enormous success in neighbouring Norway and Denmark.

title: I'm a Celebrity Australia S14
syn: The Australian edition of the celebrity jungle endurance format continues — famous Australians face Bushtucker Trials, camp politics and public elimination votes in the South African wilderness with Australian hosts Julia Morris and Dr. Chris Brown.

title: Survivor: New Zealand S4
syn: The fourth New Zealand series of the tribal survival format — Kiwi castaways compete in Fiji through physical and social challenges, building alliances and voting each other out at tribal council.

title: The Amazing Race: Asia S8
syn: The eighth Asian edition of the global travel competition — teams from across Asia race through multiple countries completing tasks and navigating cultural challenges in one of the most enduring reality franchises in the Asian television market.

title: The Traitors: Celebrity Australia
syn: The celebrity edition of the Australian Traitors, capitalising on the format's global surge — famous Australian faces in a Highland castle navigating the Faithful vs Traitor dynamic with higher stakes and higher-profile betrayals.

title: Deal or No Deal Island S2
syn: The second season of NBC's hybrid format: the iconic case game grafted onto a Survivor-style island competition. Contestants survive challenges to earn access to the giant suitcases — with the biggest prize in the format's history at stake.

title: Boiling Point (UK)
syn: A high-pressure culinary competition set inside a fully operational restaurant, following chefs through the relentless chaos of real service — the drama is real, the eliminations are real and the cooking has to be restaurant-quality or you're out.

title: Welcome Get Lost (Netflix Japan)
syn: Japanese comedy survival: comedians are placed in uncomfortable, humiliating situations and must endure constant insults and challenges from the public and their peers. Combines the Japanese variety tradition of escalating discomfort with Netflix's global comedy reach.

title: Project Runway (Africa)
syn: The first African edition of the fashion competition format, commissioned after the 2025 US revival. Emerging African designers face elimination through runway challenges celebrating the richness of African fashion and textile culture.

title: Rebooting (International)
syn: Based on Nippon TV's award-winning Japanese drama: the unscripted spin-off format explores the concept of second chances — people who have been given unexpected opportunities to restart significant chapters of their lives. Warm, redemptive and philosophically rich.

title: House of Villains US S2
syn: The second season of the reality all-star villain format: the most notorious antagonists from across American reality television — Big Brother, Real Housewives, Love Island — compete for the title of Ultimate Villain in a house of strategic chaos.

title: Gogglebox (International)
syn: The beloved Channel 4 format — ordinary families and friends watching and commenting on the week's television from their own sofas — continues its remarkable global life. New versions active across multiple markets including Australia, Ireland, Germany and beyond.

title: MILF Manor
syn: A dating show with a family-twist premise: older single mothers are looking for love — but the men they're dating turn out to be each other's sons. Two seasons produced and distributed internationally by WBITVP.

title: Survive the Raft
syn: Diverse strangers share a potential fortune — but only teamwork will see them through. A social experiment survival format: a group must live together on a raft, blending cooperation and competition as resources dwindle, alliances shift and every decision could change the course of the game. Nine episodes for Discovery US.

title: OutChef'd
syn: No prep, no warning — just one chance to outchef a pro. Amateur home cooks are surprised with a mystery challenge to beat a professional chef using identical ingredients, with no preparation time. Short-form (30'), accessible and high-stakes.

title: Say Yes to the Dress
syn: The long-running bridal boutique format following brides-to-be as they search for the perfect wedding dress at Kleinfeld Bridal in New York. One of TLC's most globally adapted titles, with local versions across 15+ countries. Produced and distributed by WBITVP.

title: Last Bite Hotel
syn: A devilishly clever cooking competition where every dish counts: chefs manage a deliberately limited and dwindling ingredient supply — the 'Last Bite Hotel' — as they must create outstanding dishes while watching key ingredients disappear. Strategy and skill collide in this Food Network format.

title: True Love
syn: A dating experiment involving truth ceremonies: Swedish couples and singles face lie-detector-style truth tests, temptations and emotional confrontations in a format built on the radical premise that real love can only survive total honesty.

title: Foul Play
syn: Sports stars attempt high-stakes pranks on the public and each other in this sports-celebrity prank format for TruTV. Hosted by Anthony Davis, it blends the energy of sports culture with classic hidden camera comedy.

title: Inside Therapy
syn: Real on-screen therapy sessions with participant consent — exploring the private world of the therapist's room as compelling primetime factual television. Created by Twenty Twenty for BBC One/iPlayer. First international adaptation: France Télévisions (Rendez-vous Chez le Psy, 5-part). Accompanied by a digital campaign and podcast.

title: The Bachelorette
syn: The female-led spin-off of The Bachelor franchise: one woman chooses from 25 suitors across a season of rose ceremonies, dates and dramatic eliminations. Part of the global Bachelor universe distributed by WBITVP.

title: FGirl Island
syn: Gender-flipped FBoy Island extension: three men must sort genuine women from self-proclaimed 'FGirls' — women there for fun rather than love — in a tropical island competition. The CW original; distributed by WBITVP.

title: Glow Up
syn: Make-up artists compete to be crowned the next great make-up talent in this BBC Three competition. Created by Wall to Wall, produced by WBITVP. Seven international adaptations including China (Tencent Video, 2023); distributed globally by WBITVP.

title: Reality Queens
syn: Dutch female reality TV stars compete in elimination challenges in various extreme locations — jungle, safari, wilderness. A franchise now spanning multiple spin-offs: Reality Queens of the Jungle, Reality Queens on Safari, Reality Queens in Search of Nirvana, Reality Queens in the Wild West. Six seasons in the Netherlands; adapted in India, Poland, Germany and beyond.

title: Back to the Frontier
syn: Three very different pioneering families travel back in time to live on the American prairie in the 1880s. They arrive by wagon train and experience every aspect of authentic frontier life — building homesteads, harvesting produce, raising animals and partying like it's 1889. Guided by frontier experts, parents and children face dramatic challenges in this immersive living history format.

title: Jungle Dads
syn: A group of 'failing' British dads — each bringing one of their children — live together in the heart of the Central American jungle for several weeks. A social experiment exploring whether extreme conditions can transform risk-averse dads into adventurous role models, with daily challenges including abseiling, cave navigation and jungle survival.

title: Who Wants to Marry My Mom?
syn: A son (or daughter) helps their single mum find love — entering her life and interfering with her dating choices, whether she wants them to or not. A warm, comedic family-dating format produced in 21+ countries including Belgium, Croatia, Norway, Spain, Germany and France. Rebooted in Spain (Cuatro) in 2024.

title: Who Wants to Marry My Son?
syn: The companion format to Who Wants to Marry My Mom?: a mother closely monitors the female contestants vying for her son's affections — and isn't shy about sharing her opinions. A globally adapted WBITVP family-dating format.

title: Driving Lessons
syn: A Dutch factual entertainment format documenting real learner drivers and their instructors through the intense, emotional and often hilarious experience of learning to drive — a universal rite of passage turned into compelling observational television.

title: Boys Like Boys
syn: Eight young gay men looking for love move into a house together for one week — getting to know each other through dates, games and honest conversations. No manufactured drama, no eliminations; just real reactions and the hope that real love might blossom. Created by Portico Media for GagaOOLala (Taiwan). WBITVP's first gay relationship format acquisition.

title: Star v Food
syn: Celebrity food challenges: famous faces attempt to recreate iconic fast-food menu items from scratch in a competition format that tests culinary skill against beloved commercial recipes. A light, accessible food entertainment format.

title: Star v Food: Survival
syn: A survival-themed spin on the Star v Food format: celebrities must cook and eat using only wild and foraged ingredients in extreme conditions — no supermarkets, no convenience foods. The premium, adventure-infused extension of the original food challenge format.

title: Test the Nation
syn: A live national IQ and general knowledge test broadcast simultaneously to millions of viewers, who take the test at home alongside studio contestants. One of television's most ambitious gameshow concepts; originated in the Netherlands and adapted in 30+ countries.

title: Impractical Jokers
syn: Four lifelong friends dare each other to say and do outrageous things in public — with the 'loser' of each episode facing a horrifying punishment. One of TruTV's longest-running hits with multiple international adaptations and spin-offs. Distributed by WBITVP.

title: The Wheel
syn: A revolutionary, feel-good celebrity quiz: a single contestant at the centre of a giant wheel must choose which of seven celebrity experts to trust for each question. Bonus rounds and 'nudges' build the prize. BBC One's most successful primetime gameshow launch in a decade. Commissioned in US (NBC), Netherlands (SBS), Germany (RTL), Finland, Spain, France (TF1), Sweden (TV4) and UAE.

title: 24 in 24: Last Chef Standing
syn: 24 chefs, 24 challenges, 24 hours — billed as the world's toughest cookery competition. Contestants face an unrelenting series of culinary tests across a single marathon day, with eliminations after each challenge. Two seasons produced for Food Network and Max in the US.

title: Friends: The Game Show
syn: Could this BE any more challenging? A Friends-themed fan challenge format for Max: dedicated fans of the iconic sitcom compete in trivia, recreations and knowledge challenges set in the world of Friends. A Warner IP-driven gameshow.

title: Harry Potter: Wizards of Baking
syn: An edible celebration of the magical world of Harry Potter: pastry chefs and bakers compete to create extraordinary Harry Potter-inspired builds and confections judged on magic, craft and storytelling. An IP-branded baking competition for Food Network and Max.

title: Human vs Hamster
syn: Humans attempt to complete challenges inspired by hamster behaviour — running wheels, maze navigation, food-gathering tasks — competing against actual hamsters in their natural element. A fun, family-oriented physical comedy format.

title: Second Chance Stage
syn: A talent competition for singers, performers and entertainers who were previously rejected, eliminated or overlooked in earlier competitions — given a second shot at a professional career in front of a new judging panel. Built on the universal appeal of redemption.

title: The List
syn: A trivia-meets-strategy gameshow in which contestants must correctly rank items in lists — by size, value, age, speed, popularity — within a time limit. The format rewards systematic thinking and real-world knowledge over pure recall.

title: Mental Samurai
syn: The ultimate test of skill, focus and stamina: contestants strap into a 360-degree rotating arm and answer questions while being spun and moved at speed, testing memory, spatial awareness and mental agility simultaneously. Fox US original; adapted in Spain (Mediaset) and internationally through WBITVP.

title: Sing Again
syn: A talent competition for singers who once had their moment in the spotlight but have since faded from public view — a second-chance singing format that discovers what happened to former pop stars and whether they still have what it takes to win over a live audience.

title: Roller Jam
syn: A roller-skating competition format: celebrities and athletes compete in roller disco, roller derby and speed challenges in a spectacular arena setting. A colourful, high-energy entertainment format drawing on the global nostalgia for roller-skating culture.

title: Lotería Loca
syn: A Spanish-language lottery-meets-gameshow format for the Hispanic market: contestants play the traditional Mexican Lotería card game in an elevated, high-stakes primetime format with celebrity hosts and escalating prize rounds.

title: Soundtrack of Love
syn: A music-driven dating experiment: singles are matched based entirely on their musical tastes and emotional responses to songs — rather than appearance or profiles. Music as a language of love, with reveals of compatibility only possible through shared emotional resonance.

title: Cash or Trash
syn: Antiques and collectibles experts assess whether everyday people's prized possessions are worth a fortune — or worthless junk. One of WBITVP and ZDF Studios' most globally travelled formats: 1,000+ episodes in Germany alone (Bares für Rares), 8,000+ globally. Adapted in 13+ countries including UK (The Bidding Room, BBC One), France, Italy, Poland, Greece, Austria and Morocco.

title: Supernanny
syn: An experienced nanny or childcare expert spends time helping families with misbehaving children and stressed parents, demonstrating innovative and time-tested methods to resolve bad behaviour, excessive screen time and modern parenting challenges. A Channel 4 classic adapted in 21+ countries globally.

title: The Repair Shop
syn: Master craftspeople restore treasured family heirlooms and precious objects brought in by their emotional owners. BBC One's warmly loved factual entertainment hit — internationally positioned by WBITVP as a soft-format alternative to competition reality. Multiple international versions and spin-offs.

title: Who Do You Think You Are?
syn: Celebrities trace their family history and ancestry with the help of professional genealogists — often uncovering surprising, moving and historically significant stories. One of BBC One's longest-running factual formats; adapted in 20+ countries including US, Australia, Ireland, Canada and Israel.

title: House Hunters
syn: A couple or individual searches for a new home, touring three properties before making their final choice — with personal priorities and budget realities always in tension. HGTV's most enduring format: 250+ seasons, international editions including House Hunters International.

title: The Repair Shop: On the Road
syn: The Repair Shop goes on location: master craftspeople travel across Britain to discover dying craft skills and restore objects in situ, bringing the warmth of the original format to new settings and communities beyond the iconic barn.

title: Back in Time For…
syn: Time-travelling families transform their homes and lives to experience life decade by decade — from the 1940s through to the 1980s — living authentically within the food, clothing, technology and social norms of each era. An immersive living-history format from Wall to Wall with multiple series and spin-offs.

title: Five Star Chef
syn: Chefs compete to win a stunning restaurant prize — the chance to run their own five-star establishment. A high-stakes culinary competition combining cooking talent with entrepreneurial vision, produced by Twenty Twenty for Channel 4 UK and distributed on Netflix internationally.

title: The Nevermets
syn: Long-distance online lovers meet each other in real life for the first time — having built deep emotional connections entirely through screens. A documentary-reality format exploring modern digital love: the joy and terror of moving from pixels to physical presence.

title: Brides in Business
syn: Bridal industry entrepreneurs and wedding business owners compete to land major clients and contracts in a business-meets-bridal competition format — combining the commercial energy of The Apprentice with the glamour and emotion of the wedding industry.

title: Cook Once, Eat Twice
syn: A practical cooking format built around the concept of batch cooking and clever repurposing: chefs and food presenters demonstrate how to prepare one core ingredient or dish and transform it into multiple distinct meals, with a strong focus on household economy and reducing waste.

title: My Dream Green Home
syn: A property and lifestyle format following homeowners as they transform their homes into sustainable, eco-friendly living spaces — working with green architects, sustainable builders and environmental experts to reduce their carbon footprint without sacrificing comfort or design.

title: What's the Big Deal?
syn: A negotiation-based gameshow in which contestants must identify which of several offered 'deals' hides the biggest prize — through a combination of instinct, psychological reading of the host and logical deduction. High-stakes, fast-paced and endlessly adaptable.

title: Born From The Same Stranger
syn: People who were conceived using donor sperm search for and meet their genetic half-siblings — strangers who share a biological father but have lived completely separate lives. A deeply emotional documentary-reality format exploring identity, family and the complexity of donor conception.

title: Bring the Drama
syn: A competitive drama performance format in which contestants — amateur actors, drama students and passionate performers — compete in acting challenges judged by industry professionals. Equal parts talent show and psychological game as performers reveal and conceal their true selves.

title: Food Unwrapped
syn: An investigative food factual series that reveals the surprising truth behind everyday food products — what's actually in them, how they're made and where they come from. Channel 4's long-running food investigation format, internationally distributed by WBITVP.

title: My Family Mystery
syn: Families uncover hidden or unknown chapters of their collective history — adoptions, wartime stories, secret relatives — in a warmly produced documentary-reality format that combines genealogical research with personal journeys of discovery and reconciliation.

title: Outsiders
syn: A social experiment adventure format in which participants from radically different social backgrounds are placed together in extreme or unfamiliar environments — challenging their assumptions, testing their resilience and revealing what connects people across social divides.

title: Toy Hospital
syn: Skilled toy restorers bring beloved but broken childhood toys and games back to life for their emotional owners — applying the warmth and craft of The Repair Shop to the uniquely nostalgic world of toys. A spin-off concept from the WBITVP craft-restoration format stable.

title: FBoy Survival
syn: The Indian adaptation of FBoy Island — blending the format's dating-competition premise with a survival-adventure setting in a harsh desert environment. Discovery India's 20-episode local version, produced by Fox6 Media. Launched February 2026; the first FBoy adaptation to incorporate a genuine survival challenge alongside the dating game.

title: Reality Queens of the Jungle: Family Edition
syn: The latest extension of the Reality Queens franchise: familiar Dutch reality stars tackle the jungle alongside a member of their own family — a relative who knows them best. Demanding challenges and jungle trials test both the star-family bond and individual resilience in this Videoland commission.

title: FBoy Island (India)
syn: The Indian commission of the FBoy Island format, produced by Fox6 Media for Discovery Channel and D+ India. Announced October 2025, launching February 2026. FBoy Island now has active versions in Australia, Belgium, Denmark, Netherlands, New Zealand, Sweden and India.

title: $25 Million Dollar Hoax
syn: A woman pretends to have won a $25 million lottery and must convince her family the money has changed her personality — testing family loyalty and revealing reactions to sudden wealth. One of the early prank-reality experiments to centre deception on the immediate family.

title: 'Til Death Do Us Part: Carmen and Dave
syn: MTV reality series following Carmen Electra and Dave Navarro as they plan their wedding — an intimate celebrity access format capturing the drama and emotions of a high-profile relationship. Part of the early 2000s celebrity docu-reality wave.

title: 100 Hours
syn: New Zealand reality competition in which contestants competed across mental, physical and dexterity-based challenges under continuous camera coverage — an early local iteration of the multi-discipline competition format with strategy and bluffing elements.

title: 12 Corazones
syn: Spanish-language dating game show in which contestants are identified by zodiac signs and pair off through games and audience voting. One of Telemundo's longest-running original unscripted formats, blending astrology with studio dating spectacle.

title: 13: Fear Is Real
syn: Horror-themed reality competition in which contestants face fear-based challenges and psychological stress in an elimination format. An early attempt to fuse horror atmosphere with the elimination mechanics of mainstream reality competition.

title: 19 Kids and Counting
syn: Documentary-style reality following the Duggar family — a very large, deeply conservative Christian family — through daily life with 19 children. One of TLC's defining faith-and-family factual entertainment formats.

title: 30 Days (TV series)
syn: Morgan Spurlock-created social experiment in which participants spend 30 days living in circumstances radically different from their own — challenging perspectives on immigration, religion, disability and culture through immersive lived experience.

title: 3AM (TV series)
syn: Observational series following performers, nightlife figures and cultural players through New York City's late-night scene — an access documentary capturing subculture and celebrity at the intersection of performance and private life.

title: 8th & Ocean
syn: MTV docu-soap following young models living and competing in Miami's South Beach fashion scene — an aspirational access format tracking the daily realities of early-career modelling ambition.

title: A Casa (TV series)
syn: Brazilian reality format in which a large number of contestants are crowded into one house and compete for survival through social pressure and scarcity — an overcrowded-house endurance experiment from RecordTV.

title: A Fazenda
syn: Brazilian version of The Farm: celebrities are placed on a rural farm where they complete agricultural tasks, face eliminations and compete for public votes. One of Brazil's highest-rated ongoing reality formats with 15+ seasons.

title: A Makeover Story
syn: TLC lifestyle makeover series in which participants receive complete style and appearance transformations — a simple before-and-after format that established TLC's identity as a home for personal transformation reality.

title: A Shot at Love with Tila Tequila
syn: Dating competition in which both men and women competed for a relationship with bisexual social media personality Tila Tequila — a groundbreaking premise for its time that brought LGBTQ+ representation to mainstream cable dating formats.

title: Abby's Ultimate Dance Competition
syn: Youth dance competition series hosted by Abby Lee Miller (Dance Moms) in which young dancers competed through high-pressure performance challenges — combining competitive dance with the heated dynamics of stage parents and demanding coaching.

title: Adorableness (TV series)
syn: Comedy clip show built around cute and heartwarming viral videos — a spin-off from the Ridiculousness format family, leaning into feel-good content for MTV's younger digital audience.

title: Afghan Star (TV series)
syn: Afghan singing competition based on the Idol format with public voting — widely considered one of the most significant media and cultural events in post-Taliban Afghanistan, documented in an award-winning film of the same name.

title: Age of Love (TV series)
syn: Dating series in which tennis player Mark Philippoussis dated women from two age groups — framed as 'kittens' (20s) vs 'cougars' (40s) — exploring generational attitudes to attraction and long-term compatibility.

title: Ainori
syn: Japanese reality series in which young singles travel together overseas in a distinctive pink van, pursuing romance along the way. One of the most iconic Japanese unscripted formats; revived on Netflix Japan in 2017.

title: Airline (1998 TV series)
syn: British observational docu-soap following staff and passengers at easyJet — one of the defining UK workplace reality formats of the late 1990s, generating strong ratings through real customer conflict and operational chaos.

title: Airline (American TV series)
syn: American adaptation of the Airline format following Southwest Airlines employees and passengers — translating the UK workplace-reality model to a major US carrier with a focus on customer service pressure and everyday drama.

title: Airport (TV series)
syn: BBC fly-on-the-wall documentary series about Heathrow Airport staff and operations — one of the BBC's longest-running and most-watched observational documentary series, establishing the airport as a defining unscripted format location.

title: Alaskan Bush People
syn: Series following the Brown family as they live and work in remote parts of Alaska and the Pacific Northwest — an off-grid survivalist family format built on an extreme lifestyle identity.

title: Almost Genius
syn: Comedy clip show featuring internet videos of people attempting unusual or risky ideas — celebrating near-brilliant human attempts and the fine line between genius and spectacular failure.

title: America's Best Dance Crew
syn: Dance crew competition in which groups performed choreographed routines and advanced through weekly judging and audience votes. MTV's flagship dance format; launched numerous careers in street and commercial dance.

title: America's Funniest Home Videos
syn: The original and longest-running US home-video comedy format: viewer-submitted funny clips compete for cash prizes. A foundational format in the history of unscripted television, now 36+ seasons and still airing.

title: America's Funniest Home Videos: Animal Edition
syn: Animal-focused spin-off of America's Funniest Home Videos featuring humorous pet and animal clips — extending the franchise to a nature and pet-loving audience on Nat Geo Wild.

title: America's Funniest People
syn: Spin-off of America's Funniest Home Videos combining comedy home videos with sketches and amateur performances — an early experiment in expanding the home-video format into broader variety territory.

title: America's Most Smartest Model
syn: VH1 modelling competition that tested contestants on both physical appearance and general intelligence — deliberately challenging model stereotypes through academic-style tests alongside runway and photo challenges.

title: America's Most Wanted
syn: Long-running public-service reality series profiling real fugitives and asking viewers to help law enforcement locate suspects — one of the most socially impactful unscripted formats in American television history, credited with helping capture 1,000+ criminals.

title: America's Next Top Model
syn: Tyra Banks's modelling competition in which aspiring models competed through photo shoots, runway challenges and eliminations. One of the most influential reality formats of the 2000s — spawning 20+ international adaptations and defining aspirational fashion reality.

title: America's Top Dog
syn: Competition series in which elite police K9s and civilian dogs run obstacle-course challenges with their handlers — a format celebrating the bond between working dogs and their partners across a range of demanding disciplines.

title: America's Worst Driver
syn: Reality series that put self-identified bad drivers through challenges designed to identify and correct America's worst driving habits — a combination of comic incompetence and genuine driving education.

title: American Candidate
syn: Reality competition in which civilian candidates competed through campaign-style challenges to become a mock presidential candidate — a rare experiment in treating democratic politics as a reality contest format.

title: American Casino
syn: Reality series following employees and the daily operations of the Green Valley Ranch casino in Las Vegas — an observational workplace format set in the high-stakes, 24-hour atmosphere of a Nevada casino resort.

title: American Chopper
syn: Series following Orange County Choppers as the Teutul family build custom motorcycles under deadline pressure — combining craft spectacle with explosive father-son conflict in one of Discovery's defining reality formats.

title: American Dream Builders
syn: Design competition in which professional builders and designers renovated American homes in team-based challenges — a short-lived NBC attempt to bring competitive home renovation to primetime.

title: American Grit
syn: Teams of civilians faced military-style endurance and survival challenges under the guidance of real special operations veterans — combining military discipline with personal resilience in a physically demanding competition format.

title: American Hot Rod
syn: Series following Boyd Coddington's legendary hot-rod shop as vehicles were designed, built and delivered under intense deadline pressure — a craft-and-deadline format built on automotive artistry and shop floor conflict.

title: American Idol
syn: The US adaptation of Pop Idol: the original and most globally successful singing competition format. Singers audition, perform live and are eliminated by public vote. 24 seasons; launched the careers of Kelly Clarkson, Carrie Underwood, Jennifer Hudson and many more.

title: American Inventor
syn: Reality competition in which everyday inventors pitched their products and competed for development funding and prize money — an early precursor to the Dragon's Den/Shark Tank inventor competition format.

title: American Juniors
syn: American Idol spin-off focused on child singers competing for spots in a manufactured youth pop group — an early experiment in extending the Idol franchise to younger demographics.

title: American Pickers
syn: Series following Mike Wolfe and Frank Fritz as they travel across America searching for antiques, collectibles and buried treasures in barns, estates and storage spaces — one of History Channel's most durable and popular unscripted formats.

title: American Restoration
syn: Series centred on Rick's Restorations and partner shops bringing vintage objects, signage and vehicles back to their original condition — a craft-restoration format built around before-and-after reveals and the stories behind the objects.

title: Amish in the City
syn: Reality series in which young Amish people on rumspringa and non-Amish participants lived together in Los Angeles — a coming-of-age culture-clash experiment exploring identity, belief and the transition from a closed community into the modern world.

title: An American Family
syn: Landmark early documentary series following the Loud family — widely cited as one of the first true reality television formats. Its fly-on-the-wall approach and capture of a real family's dissolution set a template that would define the genre for decades.

title: Antiques Roadshow
syn: Travelling appraisal series in which experts assess antiques and collectibles brought in by members of the public — a warmly beloved format built on surprise value reveals and the personal histories behind objects. One of the most durable unscripted formats globally.

title: Are You Hot?
syn: Reality competition in which contestants were judged solely on their physical attractiveness by celebrity panellists — a deliberately provocative premise that generated controversy but short-lived ratings.

title: Around Naija
syn: Nigerian travel reality programme exploring locations, people and culture across Nigeria — one of the country's early unscripted formats to treat national identity through a road-trip discovery lens.

title: Arthur Godfrey's Talent Scouts
syn: One of the earliest American television talent shows: Arthur Godfrey presented performers competing for audience approval. An important precursor to the modern talent competition format that launched careers including Patsy Cline and Tony Bennett.

title: Asayan
syn: Japanese variety and audition programme best known for launching music acts including Morning Musume. One of the most influential Japanese talent-discovery formats, documenting the behind-the-scenes creation of pop groups through extended audition processes.

title: Auction Hunters
syn: Series following Allen Haff and Clint Jones as they bid on abandoned storage units and sell valuable items they discover inside — a treasure-hunting docu-reality built on the thrill of unknown contents and the art of the resale.

title: Audrina
syn: Reality series following Audrina Patridge (The Hills) after her departure from that show — tracking her career, family relationships and personal life as she navigated post-reality celebrity.

title: Australia's Funniest Home Videos
syn: Australian version of the global home-video comedy format — featuring viewer-submitted clips of accidents, pet antics and family mishaps. Ran for over 20 years on Nine, making it one of Australia's longest-running unscripted entertainment programmes.

title: Australia's Next Top Model
syn: Australian adaptation of the Tyra Banks Top Model format — aspiring Australian models competed through photo shoots, runway challenges and eliminations, making it one of Australia's defining fashion reality formats.

title: Australian Idol
syn: Australian adaptation of the Idol singing competition format — a national search for pop talent through auditions, live performances and public voting. Revived in 2023 after a decade off air.

title: Australian Princess
syn: Transformation reality series in which ordinary Australian women were trained in aristocratic etiquette and social skills by English finishing-school experts — an aspirational makeover format built on the Cinderella fantasy of social elevation.

title: Average Joe (show)
syn: Dating show in which a woman expecting conventionally attractive suitors was instead introduced to average-looking men — with later series adding handsome men as twists. A format that interrogated the gap between physical standards and genuine connection.

title: Ax Men
syn: Series following logging crews working in dangerous forests and timber environments across the Pacific Northwest — an occupational reality format built on physical danger, mechanical complexity and the raw power of industrial logging.

title: BBQ Pitmasters
syn: Series following competitive barbecue teams and champion pitmasters as they cook for contests and face expert judging — a celebration of American regional barbecue culture and the near-religious devotion of competitive smoke cooking.

title: Bachelor Pad
syn: The Bachelor franchise spin-off in which former contestants from The Bachelor and The Bachelorette lived together and competed in challenges combining romance with strategy for a $250,000 prize — an alumni competition format that preceded Bachelor in Paradise.

title: Bachelor in Paradise
syn: Bachelor franchise beach-resort spin-off in which former Bachelor and Bachelorette contestants date at a Mexican resort and participate in rose ceremonies — a rotating, sequel-oriented dating format that has run for 10+ seasons.

title: Back to Reality (UK)
syn: British series bringing together former reality TV contestants from multiple shows for a new competition — an early meta-reality experiment that anticipated the all-stars format trend by over a decade.

title: Backyard Blitz
syn: Australian lifestyle series in which backyards and outdoor spaces were redesigned and transformed for deserving homeowners — one of Australia's pioneering home makeover formats and a Nine Network ratings staple.

title: Bad Girls Club
syn: Reality series placing women with confrontational personalities together in a shared mansion to follow conflict, drama and attempted personal growth — Oxygen's defining docu-soap format over 17 seasons.

title: Bands Reunited
syn: Series in which VH1 attempted to reunite disbanded music groups for one-off performances — a nostalgia format built on band history, lingering grievances and the question of whether musical chemistry survives years of separation.

title: Bands on the Run
syn: Reality competition following unsigned bands simultaneously touring different US cities and competing on merchandise sales, ticket sales and fan engagement — a grassroots music hustle format.

title: Bar Rescue
syn: Jon Taffer's expert business intervention format: failing bars are diagnosed, renovated and relaunched under intense, confrontational guidance. One of the most long-running business makeover formats in American cable television.

title: Basketball Wives
syn: Celebrity-adjacent docu-soap following women romantically linked to professional basketball players — navigating friendship, status, conflict and personal growth in one of VH1's most enduring ensemble reality formats.

title: BattleBots
syn: Competition series in which engineering teams build remote-controlled fighting robots and battle them in an armoured arena — a format that celebrates creative destruction and STEM ingenuity in equal measure. Multiple revival seasons.

title: Battle of the Ex Besties
syn: Competition series in which former best friends were paired together in challenges designed to test whether they could work together and repair their fractured relationships — an emotional repair-through-competition format.

title: Beadle's About
syn: British hidden-camera prank series hosted by Jeremy Beadle — one of the most beloved and long-running prank formats in UK television history, running for 14 series and building complex, sustained setups around unwitting members of the public.

title: Bear Whisperer
syn: Series following wildlife expert Steve Searles as he managed bear encounters in Mammoth Lakes, California — a specialist nature-meets-reality format built around a charismatic expert and the genuine danger of human-bear conflict.

title: Beat the Clock
syn: Classic studio gameshow in which contestants must complete physical stunts and tasks before time runs out — one of television's earliest and most widely adapted timed-challenge formats, originating in the 1950s.

title: Beauty and the Geek
syn: Social experiment and competition pairing women labelled 'beauties' with men labelled 'geeks' — challenging both sets of stereotypes through mutual education and social skill challenges. Adapted internationally including Australia, UK and Asia.

title: Beg, Borrow & Deal
syn: Reality competition in which teams travelled across the United States completing tasks with little or no money — a resourcefulness race testing negotiation, hustle and charm in the earliest days of the travel-competition format.

title: Beija Sapo
syn: Brazilian youth dating game show featuring playful studio dating rounds and audience interaction — an early Latin American adaptation of the MTV-style dating format for a young domestic audience.

title: Being Bobby Brown
syn: Reality series offering unfiltered access to singer Bobby Brown, Whitney Houston and their family life — one of the most candid and controversial celebrity docu-realities of its era, capturing a famous couple at a turbulent moment.

title: Below Deck
syn: Series following crew members living and working aboard luxury charter yachts during season — combining high-end service pressure, crew romance and interpersonal conflict in one of Bravo's most internationally successful docu-soap formats. Multiple spin-offs.

title: Below Deck Mediterranean
syn: Below Deck spin-off following yacht crews serving charter guests in Mediterranean locations — the same high-pressure service format with European glamour settings and a rotating cast of maritime hospitality staff.

title: Best Ink
syn: Tattoo artist competition in which contestants completed ink challenges under time pressure and were judged on technical skill, creativity and execution — a specialist craft competition from Oxygen's alternative reality slate.

title: Big Brother (American TV series)
syn: US adaptation of the Dutch social experiment: housemates live under constant surveillance, compete for power in weekly competitions and vote each other out. One of CBS's most durable summer reality formats, now in its 26th season.

title: Big Brother (Brazil)
syn: Brazilian edition of Big Brother — one of the most watched television programmes in Brazil with massive national reach. Known for its record-breaking public voting audiences and its role as a cultural event.

title: Big Brother (UK)
syn: UK edition of the surveillance house format — one of the defining unscripted formats in British television history, with landmark seasons on Channel 4, a Channel 5 revival and an ITV relaunch from 2023.

title: Big Brother (franchise)
syn: The global Big Brother franchise: strangers isolated in a house under constant camera surveillance face nominations and evictions. The most adapted social experiment format in television history — 50+ versions across every inhabited continent.

title: Black Love (TV series)
syn: Documentary series featuring Black couples sharing intimate stories of their relationships — how they met, how they stayed together and how they navigate love. A positive-representation format celebrating Black romance and long-term partnership.

title: Blind Date (US television)
syn: Syndicated dating format sending American singles on blind dates and annotating the footage with comic captions and thought bubbles — an influential format in making everyday dating compelling and funny for a mainstream audience.

title: Blow Out (TV series)
syn: Reality series following celebrity hairstylist Jonathan Antin as he managed his Beverly Hills salons and launched his own hair-care product line — an early brand-building celebrity docu-reality on Bravo.

title: Boiling Points
syn: MTV hidden-camera format testing how long people can maintain their composure while being subjected to staged irritating and infuriating situations — contestants receive cash rewards for not losing their temper.

title: Bondi Vet
syn: Australian factual series following veterinarians — especially at Bondi Junction Veterinary Hospital — treating animals and managing complex cases. One of the most popular animal welfare formats in Australian television.

title: Boot Camp (TV series)
syn: Early reality competition in which contestants underwent authentic boot-camp-style military training and faced weekly eliminations for a cash prize — one of the first formats to subject civilians to real military physical and psychological pressure.

title: Born Diva
syn: Series following plus-size singers as they developed their vocal and performance skills in competition — an early format shining a light on underrepresented body types in mainstream music talent television.

title: BossBabes
syn: New Zealand docu-reality series following a group of young entrepreneurial women navigating their personal and professional lives — an early local iteration of the female-entrepreneur lifestyle docu-soap format.

title: Boston EMS
syn: Short-run documentary series following emergency medical technicians and paramedics working in Boston — a real emergency-services access format built on high-stakes frontline medical decisions.

title: Boston Med
syn: Documentary series following doctors, nurses and patients at Boston-area hospitals through real medical cases — one of ABC's premium hospital access documentaries, produced with the cooperation of leading Boston medical institutions.

title: Botched (TV series)
syn: Series following celebrity plastic surgeons Terry Dubrow and Paul Nassif as they attempt to repair extreme cosmetic surgery complications — combining the grotesque with genuine medical expertise in one of E!'s most distinctive and durable formats.

title: Boy Meets Boy (TV)
syn: Groundbreaking dating show in which a gay bachelor chose from male suitors — with the twist that some contestants were secretly straight and would win money if chosen. One of the first LGBT-centred primetime US reality dating formats.

title: Boys will be Girls
syn: UK social experiment in which young men lived their daily lives while presenting as women — exploring gender perceptions and social behavior through a lived immersive experience. An early gender-swap reality experiment for Channel 4's youth network.

title: Brandy & Ray J: A Family Business
syn: Reality series following siblings Brandy and Ray J Norwood as they managed careers, family relationships and a joint entertainment business — a sibling celebrity docu-reality from VH1's early 2010s personality-driven unscripted slate.

title: Branson Famous
syn: Reality musical docu-series following the Mabe family and their long-running variety show in Branson, Missouri — an inside look at a small-town showbusiness dynasty maintaining a multi-generational entertainment tradition.

title: Brat Camp
syn: Reality series sending troubled teenagers to wilderness-therapy programmes to address behaviour and family conflict — an early UK-US co-production exploring the emotional and social turnaround of at-risk youth.

title: Braxton Family Values
syn: Reality series following singer Toni Braxton and her sisters as they navigate family relationships, career pressures and personal conflicts across nine seasons on WE tv.

title: Breaking Amish
syn: Series following young adults from Amish and Mennonite communities experiencing life outside their communities for the first time — navigating the culture clash between traditional values and modern city life.

title: Breaking Amish: Brave New World
syn: Spin-off following Breaking Amish cast members as they continue building independent lives after leaving their religious communities — a post-exit follow-up journey.

title: Bridalplasty
syn: Competition in which brides-to-be competed in weekly challenges to win cosmetic surgery procedures toward a dream wedding. An extreme premise combining bridal competition with plastic surgery elimination.

title: Bring It! (TV series)
syn: Lifetime series following the Dancing Dolls hip-hop majorette team and their formidable coach Dianna Williams through intensive training and competitions — combining athletic pressure with parent-coach conflict.

title: Bringing Up Bates
syn: Reality series following Gil and Kelly Jo Bates and their large Tennessee family — a faith-centred family observational format built on the everyday logistics and warmth of a very large conservative household.

title: Britain's Got Talent
syn: British open-variety talent competition in which acts of all types — singers, dancers, magicians, comedians and novelty performers — compete for a Royal Variety Performance slot and cash prize. Part of the global Got Talent franchise created by Simon Cowell.

title: Britain's Next Top Model
syn: British adaptation of the Top Model format: aspiring British models compete through photo shoots, runway tasks and panel eliminations across 12 series, with a career-changing modelling contract as the prize.

title: Britain's Worst Celebrity Driver
