title: I Kissed a Boy (TV series)
syn: BBC Three queer male dating format in which gay men are introduced with a kiss before exploring romantic compatibility — a bold, positive representation format for BBC's youth digital network.

title: I Kissed a Girl (TV series)
syn: BBC Three queer female companion format to I Kissed a Boy — women dating women after being paired and introduced with a kiss. Continues BBC Three's commitment to LGBTQ+ representation in dating reality.

title: I Know My Kid's a Star
syn: VH1 competition in which child performers and their parents competed for a talent-management prize — a format exploring stage ambition filtered through often extreme parental pressure.

title: I Love Money
syn: VH1 reality competition bringing together contestants from Flavor of Love, Rock of Love and I Love New York — franchise alumni competing for cash in physical and social challenges.

title: I Love New York (TV series)
syn: VH1 dating competition starring Tiffany 'New York' Pollard — a Flavor of Love breakout personality — as men competed for her attention. One of VH1's most successful spin-off formats.

title: I Married a Princess
syn: Lifetime reality series following actor Casper Van Dien and his wife Catherine Oxenberg — a former princess — through their blended Hollywood family life.

title: I Survived a Japanese Game Show
syn: ABC reality competition in which American contestants travelled to Japan to compete in an absurd Japanese-style game show, combining fish-out-of-water culture comedy with physical challenge elimination.

title: I Survived a Zombie Apocalypse
syn: BBC Three reality survival competition set inside a simulated zombie apocalypse — contestants lived in and navigated a realistic undead scenario while facing elimination tasks in a genre role-play format.

title: I Wanna Marry Harry
syn: Fox reality series in which women were led to believe they might be dating the real Prince Harry — while actually dating a carefully prepared lookalike — a fairytale romance hoax built on the global fascination with the British royal family.

title: Ice Loves Coco
syn: E! series following rapper and actor Ice-T and his wife Coco Austin through their daily life and relationship — two seasons of unexpectedly warm celebrity domesticity.

title: Ice Road Truckers
syn: History Channel series following truck drivers hauling freight across frozen lakes and Arctic roads under extreme weather conditions — an occupational docu-reality built on genuine physical danger and logistics pressure.

title: Idol (TV series)
syn: The global Idol franchise originating from Pop Idol (UK, 2001): singers compete through regional auditions, live shows and public voting. One of the most globally adapted television formats in history — 50+ national versions.

title: Idol Philippines
syn: Philippine adaptation of the Idol franchise — singers competing through auditions and live performance rounds for public votes in one of Southeast Asia's most enthusiastic singing competition markets.

title: Ilha Record
syn: Brazilian island survival reality show on RecordTV in which celebrities lived on an island and competed in challenges — RecordTV's answer to Survivor-style island competition.

title: Indonesia's Next Top Model
syn: Indonesian adaptation of the Top Model franchise — aspiring models competing through photo shoots, runway challenges and elimination rounds for a professional contract.

title: Indonesian Idol
syn: Indonesian adaptation of the Idol singing competition — one of Southeast Asia's most popular talent formats with a massive national audience and multiple seasons.

title: Infinite Challenge
syn: South Korean variety programme running 14 years in which cast members undertook comedic, physical and social challenges across constantly changing concepts — one of the most influential Korean variety formats and a direct precursor to modern K-variety formats.

title: Ink Master
syn: Long-running tattoo artistry competition on Spike and Paramount Network in which tattoo artists complete technical and creative challenges on real clients, judged on skill, precision and artistry.

title: Intervention (TV series)
syn: A&E's landmark intervention documentary: following people with addictions and the families who love them, culminating in a formal intervention and offer of treatment. One of American television's most emotionally powerful documentary-reality formats.

title: Invasion Iowa
syn: Spike TV series in which William Shatner and a team of actors staged a fake film production in Riverside, Iowa — a town-scale celebrity deception that turned an entire community into unknowing participants.

title: It's Me or the Dog
syn: British series following dog trainer Victoria Stilwell as she helped owners correct difficult pet behaviour — a warm, practical animal-intervention format that ran for multiple series and an American spin-off on Animal Planet.

title: Jamie's Kitchen
syn: Channel 4 documentary series following Jamie Oliver as he trained 15 unemployed young people at his new restaurant, Fifteen — a social mission through culinary skill-building that became one of Channel 4's most impactful factual formats.

title: Jamie Oliver's Food Revolution
syn: Cross-Atlantic series following Jamie Oliver's campaign to improve school and community diets in the United States — a celebrity chef tackling institutional food culture in Huntington, West Virginia and Los Angeles.

title: Jersey Shore (TV series)
syn: MTV's defining shared-house format: young Italian-American housemates in New Jersey, Miami and Italy party, fight and pursue romance. One of MTV's highest-rated formats and a cultural phenomenon that launched multiple spin-offs globally.

title: Jerseylicious
syn: Style Network docu-soap following the staff of New Jersey hair and beauty salons — a regional workplace reality built on big personalities, beauty culture and interpersonal drama.

title: Jhalak Dikhhla Jaa
syn: Indian adaptation of Dancing with the Stars — celebrities paired with professional choreographers for elaborate dance routines judged weekly by a panel. One of India's most popular and long-running celebrity dance competition formats.

title: Jockeys (TV series)
syn: Animal Planet series following professional horse-racing jockeys at tracks in Southern California — a sports docu-reality capturing the physical risk, competitive pressure and behind-the-scenes lives of elite flat-racing athletes.

title: Big Brother (franchise)
syn: The foundational social experiment reality format: strangers are isolated in a house under 24/7 camera surveillance, nominate each other for eviction and are voted out by the public. Created by John de Mol in the Netherlands in 1999 and now the most widely adapted social experiment format in television history — 50+ national versions across every inhabited continent.

title: Road Rules
syn: MTV's second reality show and a pioneer of travel-adventure reality television: five to six young strangers travel in an RV across countries with no money, completing missions and challenges at each stop. Created by Jonathan Murray and Mary-Ellis Bunim, it ran 14 seasons and generated The Challenge spin-off franchise.

title: The Great Interior Design Challenge
syn: BBC Two competition searching for Britain's best amateur interior designers — contestants transform real rooms in clients' homes across four series, judged on creativity, practicality and design vision. Presented by Tom Dyckhoff; produced by Studio Lambert.

title: Love Island (original)
syn: ITV2's flagship villa-dating competition: singles couple up in a sun-soaked location, recouple with new arrivals and are eliminated by public vote. The format that redefined British summer television and spawned global adaptations including Love Island USA, Australia, Germany, France, Sweden and beyond.

title: The Circle (original)
syn: Social media-themed reality competition in which contestants live in separate apartments in a building, communicating only through a bespoke social media platform and rating each other's profiles for popularity. Players can use their real identity or catfish as someone else. Created by Tim Harcourt for Channel 4; adapted internationally including the US (Netflix), France and Brazil.

title: The Dead Files
syn: Travel Channel paranormal investigation series in which physical medium Amy Allan and retired NYPD homicide detective Steve DiSchiavi conduct completely separate investigations of allegedly haunted locations — then meet with clients in a final 'reveal' to compare findings. 15 seasons across 12 years.

title: Beauty and the Nerd (Australia)
syn: Australian adaptation of the international Beauty and the Nerd social experiment: self-declared beauties and self-declared nerds are paired together to challenge stereotypes through joint tasks and competition — updating the original format for a modern Australian audience.

title: Hunted (Channel 4)
syn: The flagship Channel 4 fugitive format: ordinary contestants attempt to evade a team of professional ex-intelligence and law-enforcement hunters for 28 days using real investigative methods. One of Channel 4's most distinctive modern formats — spawning international adaptations and the celebrity spin-off Celebrity Hunted.

title: The Challenge: All Stars
syn: Paramount+ spin-off of The Challenge bringing back iconic and beloved alumni from the original MTV franchise to compete once more — a nostalgic, fan-service extension of one of reality television's longest-running formats.

title: Kingdom (Korean variety)
syn: Mnet K-pop competition series in which established boy bands — rather than unknown artists — competed against each other in large-scale performance battles judged by industry professionals and public voting. A unique format placing already-famous groups in direct competition.

title: Queer Eye: We're in Japan!
syn: Special international edition of Queer Eye in which the Fab Five travel to Japan to transform the lives of four Japanese individuals — combining the original format's warmth with cultural exchange and the perspective shift of operating in a radically different social context.

title: Formula E: Unplugged
syn: Behind-the-scenes access documentary series following the Formula E electric racing championship — offering intimate access to drivers, teams and the unique world of street-circuit electric motorsport as the sport grew from fringe concept to global championship.

title: Take Us Home: Leeds United
syn: Amazon Prime Video access documentary following Leeds United Football Club through their 2018-19 Championship season under coach Marcelo Bielsa — an intense, warmly received sports documentary capturing one of English football's most passionate clubs at a pivotal moment.

title: Face Off (SyFy)
syn: Special-effects makeup competition on Syfy in which prosthetics and creature artists created character designs for weekly themed challenges and elimination judging — eight seasons celebrating specialist craft and fantasy artistry.

title: Restaurant: Impossible
syn: Food Network series in which chef Robert Irvine arrives at a failing restaurant with a limited budget and 48 hours to overhaul the food, décor and management — a fast-paced, high-drama business rescue format built on culinary expertise and operational diagnosis.

title: Buddy vs. Duff
syn: Food Network competition pitting cake artists Buddy Valastro (Cake Boss) and Duff Goldman against each other in head-to-head elaborate cake challenges — a celebrity craft format built on the rivalry of two of America's most famous bakers.

title: MXC
syn: American comedy re-dubbed version of the Japanese variety format Takeshi's Castle — the original footage was overdubbed with absurdist English commentary turning it into a cult hit on Spike TV. One of the earliest examples of a Japanese format being reimagined for a Western audience.

title: Airline (ITV)
syn: ITV observational series following staff and passengers at Britannia Airways — a workplace docu-soap capturing the stress, humour and conflict of a major UK airline during the era of package holidays.

title: Airports 24/7: Britain
syn: ITV documentary series giving round-the-clock access to the operations of British airports — following staff and passengers through security, check-in and the full behind-the-scenes machinery of modern air travel.

title: Bondi Rescue
syn: Long-running Australian docu-reality series following the professional lifeguards who patrol Bondi Beach in Sydney — one of Australia's most-watched and internationally sold factual entertainment formats, exported to broadcasters worldwide.

title: Mary Portas: Secret Shopper
syn: Channel 4 series in which retail expert Mary Portas went undercover as a customer to expose poor service and help businesses improve their customer experience — a consumer-affairs intervention format combining undercover investigation with practical business advice.

title: Rich House, Poor House
syn: Channel 5 social experiment format in which a wealthy family and a low-income family swap homes and budgets for a week — revealing the realities of life across Britain's economic divide and prompting reflection on inequality, values and quality of life.

title: Isis Fashion Awards
syn: Dutch fashion competition series following an international accessory design competition staged in the Netherlands — designers showcase original accessories on the catwalk in front of a live audience and professional jury.

title: Ticket to the Tribes
syn: Dutch reality adventure series in which participants travel to meet and live with remote tribes around the world — a cultural immersion travel format.

title: A.S.S. - Anti Survival Show
syn: Twelve Dutch reality stars are dropped on a deserted beach and must complete challenges to get progressively closer to a luxury yacht anchored offshore. Only one reality star earns a place on board — a last-person-standing elimination format with a deliberately anti-prestige premise.

title: Get the F*ck Out of My House
syn: Dutch social experiment in which 100 contestants are placed in a house designed for only four people. They must survive the overcrowding, scarcity and social pressure to be the last person standing and win the remaining household prize pot of €100,000.

title: Heels in the Hay
syn: Twelve Dutch city influencers swap their filtered urban lives for the unglamorous reality of the Dutch countryside — early mornings, physical labour and dirty hands. A fish-out-of-water elimination format pitting Instagram culture against agricultural reality.

title: Million Dollar Listing Nederland
syn: Dutch adaptation of the Million Dollar Listing format — following four top real estate agents competing in the Dutch luxury housing market, with access to high-stakes deals, interpersonal drama and lavish lifestyles.

title: Love Island: Aftersun (NL/BE)
syn: Dutch/Flemish companion show to Love Island Netherlands & Belgium — catching up on villa gossip, exclusive clips, a celebrity fan panel and interviews with recently eliminated islanders.

title: Kees van der Spek Ontmaskert
syn: Dutch investigative hidden-camera series in which journalist Kees van der Spek travels internationally to expose fraudsters, scammers and criminals using undercover techniques — later rebranded as Kees van der Spek: Oplichters Aangepakt!

title: The Real Housewives of Rotterdam
syn: Upcoming Dutch edition of the Real Housewives franchise following upper-class women from Rotterdam through their luxury lifestyles, friendships, rivalries and personal dramas.

title: Temptation Island VIPS
syn: Celebrity edition of the Temptation Island format: Dutch and Belgian VIPs — known faces from entertainment and social media — test their relationships by living separately among attractive singles, with temptation and confrontation as the core mechanics.

title: Echte meisjes
syn: Long-running Dutch reality format in which female celebrities from various previous reality shows are placed outside their comfort zones in survival-style scenarios — only one can be crowned top survivor. Running 15 years across multiple series.

title: Ghost Chasers
syn: Paranormal investigation series in which Kay Nambiar joins psychic Ian Lawman and investigators Paul Hobday and Chris Howley as they explore allegedly haunted locations across Europe in search of definitive evidence of the paranormal.

title: De Grannies van Amsterdam
syn: Dutch observational docu-reality following five widowed women from Amsterdam-Zuid, all around 70 years old, who share a deep bond of friendship — exploring themes of late-life love, friendship and the joy of ageing with humour and vitality.

title: Kees van der Spek: Oplichters Aangepakt!
syn: Dutch investigative reality series — the rebranded continuation of Kees van der Spek Ontmaskert — in which journalist Kees van der Spek uses hidden cameras globally to expose scammers, fraudsters and criminal operations, with a focus on protecting Dutch victims.

title: The Masked Singer (Netherlands)
syn: Dutch adaptation of the global Masked Singer format: celebrities perform in elaborate anonymous costumes while a panel of judges and the public at home try to guess their identities. One unmasked per episode until a winner is crowned. Part of the global franchise that originated in South Korea.

title: Down the Road
syn: Dutch documentary travel series in which presenter Gordon takes seven young people with Down's syndrome on a road trip across the Netherlands — a warm, boundary-shifting journey that builds friendships and challenges assumptions about people with intellectual disabilities.

title: Paradise Hotel BE/NL
syn: Benelux adaptation of the international Paradise Hotel format: singles check into a resort hotel, couple up for shared rooms, and face elimination — with new arrivals constantly disrupting existing pairings. Filmed at the same Mexican resort used for the original US series.

title: 3 op Reis
syn: Long-running Dutch travel programme in which three travellers embark on a journey, exploring destinations and discovering the cultures and people they encounter along the way — a popular and warmly regarded travel documentary format for Dutch public television.

title: De rijdende rechter
syn: Beloved long-running Dutch legal reality format in which Judge John Reid ('the travelling judge') visits citizens in dispute — neighbours, families, communities — hears both sides, and delivers a legally binding ruling on the spot. One of the Netherlands' most distinctive unscripted formats.

title: Project Dans
syn: Dutch dance competition in which 30 dancers — amateurs and rising professionals — compete to be crowned the Netherlands' best all-round dancer. Hosted by breakdancer Redo with coaches Natascha Dejong and Shaker; the winner earns a role in an ISH Dance Collective production.

title: So You Think You Can Dance (Netherlands)
syn: Dutch adaptation of the international So You Think You Can Dance format — dancers compete through auditions and weekly performance rounds judged by industry professionals and public vote, in the Dutch version of one of the world's most widely adapted dance competition formats.

title: Mr. Frank Visser doet uitspraak
syn: Dutch legal reality series in which Judge Frank Visser travels to citizens in dispute and delivers binding rulings on the spot — a popular follow-up in the tradition of De rijdende rechter, running multiple seasons on SBS6.

title: Utopia 2
syn: Second Dutch edition of the Utopia social experiment: 15 participants live permanently in a self-contained monitored area while being observed continuously by cameras — attempting to build a functioning community from scratch under 24/7 public scrutiny.

title: The Real Housewives Ultimate Girls Trip: Benelux
syn: Benelux crossover spin-off in which iconic Real Housewives cast members from the Netherlands and Belgium unite on a shared luxury holiday — combining the drama, friendships and rivalries of the regional Real Housewives franchises into a single event series.

title: Maestro (Netherlands)
syn: Dutch adaptation of the Maestro format in which celebrities with no conducting experience are trained by professional conductors and must perform in front of a live orchestra and audience — judged on musical interpretation, stage presence and technique.

title: Geer & Goor: Zoeken een hobby!
syn: Dutch celebrity mini-series following Gerard Joling and Gordon — two flamboyant Dutch entertainment figures — as they earnestly try out a series of new hobbies together, generating comedy from the clash between their extravagant personalities and ordinary pastimes.

title: Louisa & Rosanna: Onze Transgender Liefde
syn: Dutch observational docu-series following Louisa and Rosanna, a couple navigating life together through Rosanna's gender transition — one of the first Dutch reality formats to centre a transgender personal journey with warmth and intimacy over multiple years.

title: Beruchte Sloppenwijken: Ewout in de Ghetto
syn: Dutch investigative documentary mini-series in which journalist Ewout Genemans immerses himself in the world's most dangerous slums — visiting neighbourhoods where police do not operate, documenting extreme poverty, violence and the lives of people living in conditions invisible to most Dutch viewers.

title: De weddingplanners: van chaos naar champagne
syn: Dutch observational reality series following professional wedding planners as they navigate the chaos, emotion and high stakes of organising weddings — from crisis management to the champagne moment of a perfect ceremony.

title: Op zoek naar... (musical)
syn: Dutch talent search series in which the Netherlands hunts for new performers to take on title roles in major stage musicals — combining open auditions, intensive training and public voting in a format that directly feeds into live theatre productions.

title: Hvem vil være millionær? (Denmark)
syn: Danish adaptation of Who Wants to Be a Millionaire: contestants answer increasingly difficult multiple-choice questions for escalating cash prizes, with lifelines including phone-a-friend and audience vote. One of the most widely adapted gameshow formats in Danish television.

title: Ca$h Cab
syn: Hidden-camera gameshow in which unsuspecting passengers hail a taxi that turns out to be a game show set — they must answer general knowledge questions correctly during their journey to win cash, or be ejected on the spot. Originated in the UK, adapted in the US with Ben Bailey and across 20+ international markets.

title: Alene i vildmarken
syn: Danish survival competition in which ten contestants are dropped alone into remote wilderness locations with minimal equipment and must self-film their own struggle against hunger, cold and isolation. The last person remaining wins — the Danish adaptation of the international Alone format.

title: Løvens Hule
syn: Danish Dragons' Den/Shark Tank adaptation: entrepreneurs pitch business ideas to a panel of successful investor 'lions' who choose whether to invest their own money in exchange for equity. 11 seasons on DR1.

title: Hammerslag
syn: Long-running Danish property valuation gameshow in which teams compete to estimate the market value of homes and real estate across Denmark — one of the country's most durable gameshow formats.

title: Kender Du Typen?
syn: Danish lifestyle guessing format in which hosts visit a celebrity's home and attempt to deduce who lives there purely from the interior design, possessions and personal clues — without being told whose home it is.

title: Spise med Price
syn: Danish food programme following brothers James and Adam Price as they prepare recipes, explore food culture and engage in humorous culinary storytelling — one of DR's most warmly received factual formats.

title: Danmark Har Talent
syn: Danish adaptation of the Got Talent franchise: open variety competition in which singers, dancers, magicians and novelty acts perform before judges and a live audience. Danish version of Britain's Got Talent.

title: X Factor Danmark
syn: Danish adaptation of the X Factor singing competition: aspiring performers are mentored by celebrity judges and compete through live elimination rounds with audience voting.

title: Paradise Hotel (Denmark)
syn: Danish version of the Paradise Hotel format: singles live in a luxury resort, form couples and alliances, and compete to avoid elimination and win a cash prize.

title: Dagens Mand
syn: Danish dating competition in which a single woman evaluates and eliminates a group of potential romantic partners through a series of challenges and encounters over multiple episodes.

title: Vild Med Dans
syn: Danish adaptation of Strictly Come Dancing: celebrity dance competition pairing well-known personalities with professional dancers who perform weekly routines and face elimination by judges and public vote.

title: Alle Mod 1
syn: Danish interactive game show in which one studio contestant competes against the collective estimates of viewers at home — structured around the 'wisdom of crowds' theory applied to large-scale experiments and odd questions.

title: Nul Stjerner
syn: Danish adventurous travel show in which hosts Jan Elhøj and Morten Kirckhoff visit overlooked, unfashionable or poorly rated destinations to discover hidden experiences and challenge conventional travel assumptions.

title: Forræder
syn: Danish adaptation of The Traitors: contestants try to identify hidden traitors while completing group missions to build a prize fund. Psychological reality competition built on deception, trust and deduction.

title: Forræder – Ukendt Grund
syn: Civilian spin-off of Forræder in which non-celebrity participants occupy a 'Traitor' castle and play the full game of loyalty, lies and deduction — the accessible, non-celebrity version of the Danish Traitors format.

title: Stormester
syn: Danish challenge format in which 'Grandmaster' Lasse Rimmer and his assistant Mark Le Fêvre challenge five well-known Danes in creative, curly and occasionally absurd physical and mental tasks — a warmly entertaining celebrity competition.

title: De Dyre Piger
syn: Danish observational reality series following young Danish women with high-spending lifestyles — documenting their luxury habits, personal ambitions and interpersonal relationships.

title: Først Til Verdens Ende
syn: Danish adventure race format in which five couples travel across multiple countries by land and sea using limited budgets, without air travel. The first team to reach the final destination wins a prize of 250,000 kroner.

title: Natholdet
syn: Danish late-night entertainment show in which host Anders Breinholt is joined by a celebrity co-host each episode to review humorous and unintentionally funny clips from that day's media — a Danish take on the late-night clip-and-chat format.

title: Doggystyle
syn: Danish observational fiction-adjacent series following Asta, a young woman whose perfect social media image masks financial reality and professional uncertainty in Copenhagen — a character study of modern millennial life.

title: Blod, Sved og T-Shirt
syn: Danish social-experiment documentary placing young Danish participants in Indian textile factories to experience the conditions behind fast-fashion production — one of DR's most impactful factual social-experiment formats.

title: Blod, Sved og Ris
syn: Follow-up Danish social-experiment documentary in which participants live and work in Asian rice-production environments — continuing the Blod, Sved series exploring global food supply chains through lived experience.

title: Signe Molde På Udebane
syn: Danish documentary-reality series in which journalist Signe Molde immerses herself in controversial Danish subcultures and communities, meeting people with fringe or unconventional views with curiosity and humour.

title: Historien om Danmark
syn: Large-scale Danish factual documentary series charting the complete history of Denmark from prehistoric times to the modern era — combining reconstruction, expert interviews and archival material across 10 episodes.

title: Grænseland
syn: Danish historical documentary mini-series exploring the cultural, political and social history of the border region between Denmark and Germany — narrated by Lars Mikkelsen across four episodes.

title: Vilde Vidunderlige Danmark
syn: High-end Danish natural history documentary series showcasing the country's wildlife, landscapes and ecosystems — narrated by Lars Mikkelsen and produced to a Springwatch-style nature documentary standard.

title: America Says
syn: Survey-based fill-in-the-blank gameshow hosted by John Michael Higgins: contestants guess the top answers Americans gave to open-ended survey questions in a fast-paced family competition format.

title: Jeopardy!
syn: America's most iconic knowledge gameshow: three contestants compete by responding to clues in the form of answers across varied academic and pop-culture categories, with the famous reverse question-and-answer format. Alex Trebek hosted for 37 years; Ken Jennings now hosts.

title: Family Feud
syn: Survey gameshow in which two families compete to name the most popular answers to questions posed to 100 people. Steve Harvey's hosting tenure transformed the format into a global comedy juggernaut; one of the most widely adapted gameshow formats in television history.

title: The Price Is Right
syn: The longest-running American daytime gameshow: contestants compete to win prizes by correctly estimating the retail price of consumer goods across dozens of mini-games. Hosted by Bob Barker for 35 years, then Drew Carey.

title: Wheel of Fortune
syn: Word-puzzle gameshow in which contestants spin a wheel, guess letters and solve phrase puzzles to win cash and prizes — one of American television's most-watched and longest-running gameshows, hosted by Pat Sajak for 41 years.

title: The Weakest Link
syn: British general knowledge elimination quiz hosted by Anne Robinson: contestants answer questions to build a prize pot then vote off the weakest player each round. The format spawned major international adaptations including a US primetime version.

title: Lingo
syn: Word-guessing gameshow in which two teams solve mystery five-letter words to complete a Lingo card — combining elements of Wordle-style deduction with traditional gameshow competition.

title: Chain Reaction
syn: Word-association gameshow in which contestants connect words in a chain, each word linking to the next — a fast-paced vocabulary and association format running on Game Show Network.

title: Beat Shazam
syn: Music identification gameshow hosted by Jamie Foxx: teams of two race to identify songs before the Shazam app can recognise them, with the top-earning team facing a final round against Shazam itself for up to $1 million.

title: Deal or No Deal
syn: High-stakes tension gameshow originated by John de Mol: a contestant picks one of 26 briefcases, progressively eliminating others to reveal prize values while a mysterious 'Banker' makes buy-out offers. Adapted in 70+ countries.

title: Press Your Luck
syn: Revival of the classic CBS format: contestants answer trivia questions to earn spins on a big board of cash and prize values, trying to avoid the dreaded WHAMMY. Hosted by Elizabeth Banks on ABC.

title: Catch 21
syn: Blackjack-inspired trivia gameshow hosted by Alfonso Ribeiro: contestants answer questions to earn playing cards and try to build a hand as close to 21 as possible without going bust.

title: The Newlywed Game
syn: Classic couples compatibility gameshow: recently married pairs answer questions about each other and compare answers to score points — one of American television's most enduring relationship gameshows, running across multiple revival series since 1966.

title: Let's Make a Deal
syn: Revival of the classic deal-or-trade gameshow hosted by Wayne Brady: costumed contestants are offered deals and must decide whether to keep what they have or risk trading for potentially bigger prizes hidden behind curtains and in boxes.

title: Match Game
syn: Classic fill-in-the-blank panel gameshow hosted by Gene Rayburn: two contestants try to match their answers to fill-in-the-blank phrases with responses given by a panel of six celebrities — known for its adult humour and improvisational wit.

title: The Chase
syn: British quiz format hosted by Bradley Walsh: teams of contestants build a prize pot by answering questions, then face a professional 'Chaser' in a head-to-head race — one of ITV's most successful formats with US, Australian and multiple international adaptations.

title: Card Sharks
syn: Long-running card-prediction gameshow: contestants answer survey questions about how 100 people responded, then use the results to predict whether the next card in a sequence will be higher or lower — multiple revival seasons across four decades.

title: Who Wants to Be a Millionaire
syn: One of the most globally adapted gameshows in television history: contestants answer 15 multiple-choice questions of increasing difficulty for escalating cash prizes up to $1 million, with lifelines including phone-a-friend and ask the audience. Created by Steven Knight; originated on ITV UK.

title: The $100,000 Pyramid
syn: Revival of the Dick Clark classic: celebrity-contestant pairs compete to guess words and phrases on a pyramid-shaped gameboard, with Michael Strahan hosting the modern ABC version.

title: Password
syn: One of television's longest-running word games: two celebrity-contestant teams compete to guess a secret word from single-word clues — a format that has run in various forms across six decades.

title: Celebrity Name Game
syn: Celebrity word-association gameshow hosted by Craig Ferguson: celebrity guests team with contestants to identify famous names against the clock in a fun, personality-driven format.

title: The Hustler
syn: Hosted by Craig Ferguson: five players answer trivia questions but one is secretly the 'Hustler' who already knows all the answers. The others must identify who the Hustler is, or the Hustler wins the prize pot.

title: Ant & Dec's Limitless Win
syn: Hosted by Ant & Dec: a unique Saturday night quiz with no upper limit on prize money — contestants answer increasingly difficult questions and can keep building their total indefinitely, but must answer correctly to bank their winnings.

title: Are You Smarter Than a 5th Grader?
syn: Comedy quiz hosted by Jeff Foxworthy: adult contestants answer questions drawn directly from US elementary school textbooks, with child helpers providing answers — a format that spawned multiple international adaptations.

title: Idiotest
syn: Hosted by Ben Gleib: rapid-fire observation and lateral-thinking puzzles test contestants' ability to see past obvious answers — a visual trick-question gameshow on Game Show Network.

title: The Wall
syn: British version of the American high-stakes gameshow hosted by Danny Dyer: contestants answer questions while coloured balls drop down a giant wall, with correct answers leading balls to large prize zones and wrong answers sending them to zero.

title: Emogenius
syn: Emoji-decoding gameshow on Game Show Network: contestants interpret strings of emojis representing movie titles, phrases and pop-culture references to earn points and a shot at $10,000.

title: Chrissy's Court
syn: Comedy courtroom format in which model and TV personality Chrissy Teigen presides as judge over real small-claims disputes — with her mother serving as bailiff. The rulings are legally binding but the tone is playful and comedic.

title: Dishmantled
syn: Cooking competition with a destructive twist: two chefs are blasted with a cannon loaded with a mystery dish, then must identify the ingredients from what lands on them and recreate the meal. The closest recreation wins.

title: Gayme Show
syn: LGBTQ+ comedy competition in which two straight contestants — each paired with a celebrity ally — compete in physical, mental and cultural challenges to prove who is the ultimate 'Queen of the Straights'.

title: Gone Mental with Lior
syn: Celebrity mentalist Lior Suchard performs mind-reading demonstrations and psychological stunts on famous guests — blending hidden information, prediction challenges and live reactions in a short-form celebrity mentalism format.

title: Memory Hole
syn: Comedy clip format mining forgotten and embarrassing moments from pop-culture history, viral media, celebrity appearances and television archives — a nostalgia-driven comedy excavation of the recent past.

title: Murder House Flip
syn: Home renovation series focused on properties associated with notorious crimes — designers renovate the homes while exploring the true-crime stories behind them, blending property transformation with criminal history.

title: Punk'd
syn: Revival of the classic MTV hidden-camera prank format: celebrity guests are placed into elaborate staged situations designed to fool them before the prank is revealed — rebooted for Quibi's short-form platform.

title: The Sauce
syn: Short-form dance competition featuring elite dancers competing in performance-based challenges judged on creativity, technique and originality — produced for Quibi's mobile-first audience.

title: Singled Out
syn: Modern reboot of the classic MTV dating game: one eligible single eliminates potential matches through personality-based rounds, social-media clues and interactive challenges — updated for a new generation.

title: Skrrt with Offset
syn: Celebrity car culture series in which rapper Offset explores luxury automobiles, custom builds, celebrity garages and automotive lifestyles through interviews and test drives.
